coverage: Entries 109-126 of the openspec index, read in full: 2026-08-26-large-file-edit-capability, 2026-08-26-reuse-before-mint-crossfamily-dedup, 2026-08-27-live-recipe-rescues-failed-partner, 2026-08-28-escalation-disposition-executor, 2026-08-29-cross-vessel-wiring-repair, 2026-09-12-host-independent-federation-join, 2026-09-24-live-self-view (all of it), causal-attempt-ledger (proposal, design, tasks, sources, plus GAPS_OBSERVED/FINISH_LINE skimmed), consumer-side-landing-probes, contained-self-development (proposal, design, tasks), decentralized-compose-ownership (proposal, design, tasks), and 7 stray JSON fossils (add-goal-summary-*, add-new-http-response-resolver, add-summarize-goals-activity, config-patch, delete-old-http-response). Some changes the prompt named are NOT in 109-126: value-per-cost-selection, unified-install-interface, do-anything-surface, human-surface-stack, obsidian-legibility-surface, the *http-response*.ts/.js fossil family and the archive are entries 127-179, covered by openspec-8. Liveness was checked against the container push clones (/workspace/git/vessels) with merge-base --is-ancestor. It was not checked against the host repos/ checkouts, which are 5 days stale. Other live sources: shape resolves on both nodes, 24-72h journals, the live gap store (6,278 rows), the per-node attempt-ledger JSONL, and read-only SurrealDB. Timestamps are UTC, read 09-29. A temporary resolve helper was put in /tmp in both containers and then removed. Outcome convention: proposal-only entries that were never built are 'dormant' with tried='proposal only'; a replaced one is 'superseded'.

principles: Verify liveness in the tree that runs (container push clone and /vessels), not the host checkout; the host repos/ tree was 5 days stale and hid every 09-24..09-29 mechanism.
Grep every READER of a field before redefining it (5.4: one field, two readers, two meanings, a lane-wide no-op).
A consequence ledger that checks units and gates but not 'a known-good landing still lands' will settle the lane-killing commit as held.
Verify at the consuming layer, and confirm the precondition branch fires before deploying (live-recipe: three inert fixes were caught only by runtime diagnostics).
A check that reports 'did not run' as a neutral value decays silently (post-land suite ran=false for 4 weeks).
Reuse before mint also applies to the operator: consumer-side probes were superseded by registering into existing expectation loops.
Containment by scope before containment by branch: one shape and two readers, reversible by editing a record.
Exact-edit goals must use the structured EDIT block format; prose goals go through the planner and can drop edits while still reaching.
An executor whose input channel no human reads is dormant however correct it is; build the reader and the channel together.
Task checkboxes and the gap store both lag reality; neither is authoritative without a live check.
